serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: You: Hello, Mr. Landlord. #Landlord.Face.Surprised Landlord: {{punch}}Wha! {{wi}}Oh, it’s you. What is it? He seems a little on edge. #Landlord.Face.Normal You: How is the progress with the island stuff? Landlord: E-Everything is going well! It’s all good… You: So, uh…{{wi}} Are we leaving next week or later? Landlord: {{punch}}Next week?!{{wi}} I mean, uh… Next week is unlikely. You: So it will be more around next month? Landlord: Uh… #Landlord.Face.Unhappy Landlord: I don’t know! Ok?! {{punch}} Landlord: If you want you can go and deal with all this shit by yourself! You: I’m only asking… Landlord: If you want to make things quicker, you can help me instead of complaining all the time! You: Sure, I guess… I can’t really say no, he has my money. Antagonizing him now could be troublesome. But still. He’s clearly flustered about something. Landlord: One of my apartment buildings next to this one has a homeless problem. It brings down the property value a lot. Go and deal with it and maybe it will speed things up. You: How am I supposed to deal with these homeless? I don’t think I’m the man for the job. Landlord: Then stop rushing me! It will all be done! {{wi}}At some point.
